description: Compares renting and buying on net wealth rather than on monthly payment, accounting for equity, appreciation, maintenance, selling costs, and the return a renter earns on money not spent on a down payment. Returns the year buying overtakes renting. The result is highly sensitive to the appreciation and investment-return assumptions, which are returned alongside it.

inputSchema.description: Rent versus buy compared on net wealth, with the year buying pulls ahead.

annualHomeAppreciationPercent.description: Expected annual home price growth. The answer is highly sensitive to this.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Annual nominal interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.5 for 6.5%.

annualMaintenancePercent.description: Annual upkeep as a percentage of home value. Typically 1 to 2.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the purchase price, 0 to 100. Not a dollar amount.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home in US dollars.

investmentReturnPercent.description: Return a renter earns on cash not tied up in a house.

loanTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

monthlyRent.description: Current monthly rent for a comparable home.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home value. Omit and pass `state` instead to use that state's average.

sellingCostPercent.description: Cost of selling, including agent commission.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

name: calculate_rent_vs_buy

outputSchema.description: Year-by-year comparison of renting with buying, and the break-even year.

assumptions.description: Growth, appreciation and cost assumptions used.

breakEvenYear.description: Year in which buying overtakes renting; null if it does not within the horizon.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

initialCashOutlay.description: Cash needed up front to buy, in dollars.

monthlyOwnershipCostYearOne.description: Monthly cost of owning in year one, in dollars.

monthlyRentYearOne.description: Monthly rent in year one, in dollars.

yearlyComparison.description: One row per year comparing the two paths.

title: Compare renting with buying
